import Pkg
haskey(Pkg.project().dependencies, "CUDA") || Pkg.add("CUDA")
using CUDA
using LinearAlgebra
CUDA.allowscalar(false)

using JSON3

function initstacks_branchsel_b()
    branch_stack = Vector{Int64}(undef, 1)
    return branch_stack
end

function branchsel_b(loss, lossb, x, xb, y, yb, branch_stack)
    if x > y
        branch_stack[1] = 1
        loss[1] = x ^ 2 - y
    else
        branch_stack[1] = 0
        loss[1] = y ^ 2 - x
    end
    __branch = branch_stack[1]
    if __branch == 1
        xb = xb + (2x) * lossb[1]
        yb = yb + -(lossb[1])
        lossb[1] = 0.0
    else
        yb = yb + (2y) * lossb[1]
        xb = xb + -(lossb[1])
        lossb[1] = 0.0
    end
    return (xb, yb)
end

function initstacks_branchsel_b_cuda()
    branch_stack = CuArray{Int64}(undef, 1)
    return branch_stack
end

function branchsel_b_cuda(loss, lossb, x, xb, y, yb, branch_stack)
    if x > y
        CUDA.@allowscalar begin
                branch_stack[1] = 1
                loss[1] = x ^ 2 - y
            end
    else
        CUDA.@allowscalar begin
                branch_stack[1] = 0
                loss[1] = y ^ 2 - x
            end
    end
    CUDA.@allowscalar begin
            __branch = branch_stack[1]
        end
    if __branch == 1
        CUDA.@allowscalar begin
                xb = xb + (2x) * lossb[1]
                yb = yb + -(lossb[1])
                lossb[1] = 0.0
            end
    else
        CUDA.@allowscalar begin
                yb = yb + (2y) * lossb[1]
                xb = xb + -(lossb[1])
                lossb[1] = 0.0
            end
    end
    return (xb, yb)
end

function _val_init_stacks_local(fn, extra_args)
    r = fn(extra_args...)
    r === nothing && return ()
    r isa Tuple && return r
    return (r,)
end

_relerr_scalar(a, b) = abs(a - b) / max(abs(a), abs(b), 1.0)
_relerr_arr(a, b) = maximum(abs.(a .- b) ./ max.(abs.(a), abs.(b), 1.0))

__base_loss = Float64[0.05460304959607394, -1.6983738536826996, -2.083886358028651, -0.09382566154551343]
__base_x = 0.48214002373550413
__base_y = -0.56087459423313
__seed_x = [0.4765570521725671, 0.48214002373550413, -0.9561636804904537]
__seed_y = [1.0988671621599178, -0.56087459423313, 2.0448581507220966]
__seed_loss = [Float64[-2.0489085461493333, 1.6751395427788207, -1.0546846276508655, -1.1347461443231501], Float64[0.05460304959607394, -1.6983738536826996, -2.083886358028651, -0.09382566154551343], Float64[0.7283280662565068, -0.194200087596353, -0.6785755910535352, -0.4194650017617298]]
max_rel_err = 0.0
for __trial in 1:3
  loss_val_cpu = deepcopy(__base_loss); loss_sh_cpu = deepcopy(__seed_loss[__trial])
  loss_val_gpu = CuArray(deepcopy(__base_loss)); loss_sh_gpu = CuArray(deepcopy(__seed_loss[__trial]))
  x_val_cpu = __base_x; x_sh_cpu = __seed_x[__trial]
  x_val_gpu = __base_x; x_sh_gpu = __seed_x[__trial]
  y_val_cpu = __base_y; y_sh_cpu = __seed_y[__trial]
  y_val_gpu = __base_y; y_sh_gpu = __seed_y[__trial]
  stacks_cpu = _val_init_stacks_local(initstacks_branchsel_b, Any[])
  stacks_gpu = _val_init_stacks_local(initstacks_branchsel_b_cuda, Any[])
  ret_cpu = branchsel_b(loss_val_cpu, loss_sh_cpu, x_val_cpu, x_sh_cpu, y_val_cpu, y_sh_cpu, stacks_cpu...)
  ret_gpu = branchsel_b_cuda(loss_val_gpu, loss_sh_gpu, x_val_gpu, x_sh_gpu, y_val_gpu, y_sh_gpu, stacks_gpu...)
  ret_cpu_t = ret_cpu
  ret_gpu_t = ret_gpu
  local_max = 0.0
  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_arr(loss_sh_cpu, Array(loss_sh_gpu)))
  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_arr(loss_val_cpu, Array(loss_val_gpu)))
  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_scalar(ret_cpu_t[1], ret_gpu_t[1]))
  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_scalar(ret_cpu_t[2], ret_gpu_t[2]))
  global max_rel_err = max(max_rel_err, local_max)
end
println(JSON3.write(Dict("kernel" => "branchsel", "rtol" => 2.5e-14, "ok" => max_rel_err <= 2.5e-14, "max_rel_err" => max_rel_err, "device" => string(CUDA.name(CUDA.device())))))
